Before reporting a problem

Keep the evidence that explains the run.

  1. Note the device, iOS version and cameraInclude the camera make and model shown in LensPin.
  2. Describe the evidence sourceSay whether the run used GPX, nearby iPhone photos, or both—and whether a clock offset was applied.
  3. Keep the completion counts or failure reasonAdded, failed, skipped, album warnings, and EXIF fallbacks describe different outcomes.
Protect private data.

Do not send a full photo library, private GPX route, or precise home coordinates when a filename, time gap, status label, and redacted screenshot are enough.
